params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table of the forms to use; may be omitted when detailSubform is a project form

params.name: detailSubform
params.description: Name of the detail form, a POSIX path to a .json file describing it, or an object describing it

params.name: listSubform
params.description: Name of the list form, a POSIX path to a .json file describing it, or an object describing it; only valid when modifying a list-type subform

overloads.semanticRole: Dynamically replaces the detail form (and, only for list-type subforms, the list form) used by the subform object designated by object and *.

constraints: Cannot change the type (list vs. page) of the subform itself -- that can only be set in Design mode.
listSubform can only be passed when modifying a list-type subform.
Unlike other dynamic-form commands, .json paths passed here are relative to the subform's parent form, not the subform itself.

Modifying a page subform can be done at any time without disturbing current selections; modifying a list subform is only allowed while it is displaying the list -- calling it while the detail form is open (after a double-click) raises an error.
